attribution.note: Marcus's own bullet in his news roundup, stated in his voice.

semantics.note: Captures both the departure and the co-lead description. Using February 2024 for 'last two weeks' is a reasonable approximation, and the contract allows a mid-February departure.

contract.note: It requires confirmation of both the departure and the co-leadership. That is fair, because the speaker asserted both. The approximate timing window is handled leniently.

evidence.note: Contemporaneous TechCrunch report dated 13–14 Feb 2024 confirms Karpathy left OpenAI. It says nothing about co-leading an agent project.

reviews.rationale: The departure in mid-February 2024 is confirmed. The packet has no accessible evidence confirming or denying that he co-led the new agent project, and the contract needs both parts for support. Nothing contradicts the leadership claim, so the case is unresolved rather than mixed or contradicted.

attribution.note: Marcus's own bullet in his news roundup, stated in his voice.

semantics.note: Keeps the two-week window and 'mostly unexplained', and treats the 6-hour figure as tentative because of his question mark.

contract.note: The result turns on what counts as 'mostly unexplained'. The contract treats a concrete public account of the main failure mechanism as an explanation. That is an ordinary reading, though 'mostly' gives the speaker some room. Duration is fairly left unscored.

evidence.note: ITPro, 21 Feb 2024, documents serious abnormal ChatGPT responses. It was written before any cause had been confirmed.

OpenAI status page update of 21 Feb 2024 publicly identified the cause: a token-sampling bug from inference kernels in certain GPU configurations. This was eight days before the post. It is a company disclosure, but it shows an explanation was public.

reviews.rationale: The meltdown did happen on 20–21 Feb 2024. However, OpenAI published a concrete explanation of the main cause on 21 Feb, well before the 29 Feb post. That meets the contract's contradiction condition for 'mostly unexplained'. Duration is not scored.
